---
title: "Examples"
---

SCGSim owns runtime, not duplicate public notebook source. OrPen SC PDK owns
the public component-simulation examples and imports `scgsim.palace`,
`scgsim.aedt`, and `scgsim.sgb`.

## Start by task

| If you want to… | Start here |
|---|---|
| Choose a backend and see the implementation state, exercised evidence, and limits | [Backend Support Matrix](backend-support.qmd) |
| Follow a complete public component-simulation workflow | Use the canonical OrPen SC PDK notebooks listed below; SCGSim does not duplicate them. |
| Configure or reanalyze Eigenmode EPR results offline | [Eigenmode and Offline EPR](eigenmode-epr.qmd) |
| Place controls beside the notebook stage that uses them | [Notebook UX Contracts](notebook-ux.qmd) |
| Prepare a local or Slurm handoff | [Execution Profiles and Handoff](execution-profiles.qmd) |

The package-owned [Eigenmode and Offline EPR](eigenmode-epr.qmd) page records
the method-level interpretation, loss assumptions, and static snippets using
the public OrPen Xmon component. The backend specs own exact API and data
contracts. The public PDK notebooks remain the canonical source for complete
component-simulation workflows.

The [AEDT runtime contracts](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd) and
[Palace + SGB contracts](specs/palace-electrostatic-sgb.qmd) document exact
backend behavior. Report availability and result presentation belong to the
[Unified Report Model](report-model.qmd).

## Evidence boundary

A public example may link its source notebook, exact source revision, run
receipt, artifacts, physical results, convergence diagnostics, cost, and
provenance only when each item has publication authority. Private
consumer names, paths, dimensions, screenshots, meshes, configs, receipts,
artifacts, and unpublished results never belong on this site.
